result.title: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
result.summary: Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges. By separating forcing-driven background head from local withdrawal drawdown, Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC) maps local physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at the cut boundary. Supervised on unforced donor-domain withdrawal responses, these coefficients yield a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes across unseen forcing histories without refitting. We evaluate SCBC on flood-driven subsurface seepage beneath levee foundations against full-grid reference simulations (MODFLOW~6). Across three held-out foundation panels, a single frozen SCBC tree estimator reduced peak-discharge log RMSE by 26.1%, 30.9% and 42.6% relative to identical local patches using a shared boundary coefficient. We then test whether better screening forecasts improve constrained placement, minimizing peak landside toe head subject to a discharge capacity limit and a budget of three sequential full-grid checks. On a separate 36-foundation test using a coarser 30-state ring operator, a neural SCBC estimator improved discharge forecasts across candidates yet selected four over-capacity placements before checks, compared with one for a shared-coefficient ring, which recovered all 144 reference optima after three checks.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure（SCBC），把局部物理描述符映射为截断边界上的正交换系数，以封闭局部化扩散模型的边界，并在堤基渗流预报与减压井布置任务上对照 MODFLOW 6 全网格模拟评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「廉价替代算子筛选＋限次全网格校核」的序贯验证设定，可能为 LVR 中低成本预测与昂贵证据核验之间的停止与预算分配提供类比；学习式边界闭包如何保留与外部强迫的耦合，也可供核查压缩推理状态是否丢失外部条件。
